identity: selected semantic values + declaration + renderer/schema identities
ownership: explicit whole-file or bounded region; protected manual edits; occupied targets require exact bootstrap preimage
refresh: semantic source/renderer/schema changes invalidate; output writes never become source events
recovery: CAS rows + exact pending write identities + claims + preimage revalidation + renewed post-write verification
interpretation: the same semantic state serves ephemeral queries and outward files; rendered files never establish completion evidence
